Document: # Rule A4: Engage in proper aHelp etiquette. Do not use the aHelp for conversations of little substance. - Intentionally disconnecting, responding with hostility, or refusing to respond when an admin privately messages you in-game will be met with an appeal-only ban. - Additionally, abusing the aHelp relay by flooding it with garbage, checking for admins before stating a problem (ex: "hello?", "any admins?"), using it as a chatroom, or sending messages of no substance will result in your removal. - All aHelp messages are relayed to the Delta-V Discord. Just because your aHelp was not answered does not mean we cannot see it. If you would like to submit an offline Ahelp, you may do so in our Discord. - Do not discuss an ongoing aHelp with other players through OOC channels. The handling admin will let you know once the aHelp is concluded, at which point you may discuss it.
